method: 8 κ × 100 epoch Stage2 重训 (Issue #119) + pre-quantization residual pairwise Euclidean D_ref (修复 Issue #118 #119 codebook self-distance 退化)

evaluation.c_grid_v2_note: c 是 magnitude ≥ 0 (HG-Rec convention); v1 sweep 含 c=-1.0 已被 v2 排除 (球面走单独 sphere_distance 路径)
evaluation.d_ref_definition: D_ref = Euclidean pairwise distance of pre-quantization residual (z from encoder for L0, residual after L0 for L1, residual after L1 for L2)
evaluation.d_c_definition: D^(c) = curvature-c distance between assigned codebook embeddings (per item assignment via sid_output.npy)

key_findings_v2.l1_best_c_by_spearman: c=10.0 across all κ (spearman 0.1276-0.1471, monotonic increasing)
key_findings_v2.nn_overlap_best_c: c=0.01 (NN overlap always best at small c, flat across c > 0)
key_findings_v2.distortion_best_c: c=0.01 (by definition: D_c small when c small)

hyp_improvement.conclusion: Hyp. improvement is small (< 1% relative). Codebook geometry is largely insensitive to curvature choice.

metric_split.interpretation: Global rank order preserved better by hyperbolic; local neighborhood preserved equally across c (NN metric is invariant to c).

key_findings_v2.v1_correction: v1 sweep used c=-1.0 for sphere, violating HG-Rec convention (c ≥ 0). v2 excludes c=-1.0. The v1 finding 'NN overlap supports sphere' was an artifact of the sign convention. Real finding (v2): NN overlap is invariant to c (best at low c).

verdict: NO-GO for level-specific curvature: Hyp. improvement is too small (<1% Spearman gain for L0, <0.1% for L1/L2) to justify architectural complexity of per-layer curvature. Recommendation: keep v22.b baseline c=[2.0, 2.0, 2.0] (within Hyp. improvement plateau at c=2.0).
